edge_vocabulary.direction: taker -> function whose address is taken
generated output file -> input or generator file
object/artifact -> the source path it was built from
defined global symbol -> the object/artifact that exports it
environment variable -> the function that reads it

reductions.generated_from_degrades_to_file_nodes: GENERATED_FROM and BUILT_INTO connect file and object nodes; they are reached from a symbol root through EXPORTED_AS/BUILT_INTO, so they carry build provenance rather than adding callable surfaces.
reductions.relocation: 22.6 attributes a relocation to an object, not to one symbol, so a symbol's reach through RELOCATION_REFERENCE is its object's reference set; for archive members that is one translation unit, for a linked shared object it is the whole DSO.
reductions.unknown_is_dispositions_only: This plane assigns no disposition. It reads 22.12's; a reachable entity whose 22.12 disposition is UNKNOWN is the blocking set, and nothing here reclassifies.

unpopulated.reason: no plane in 22.1-22.13 observes runtime errors, state, ownership or concurrency; 22.12 recorded the same non-join. It is not derivable from any artefact this stratum carries.
no plane in 22.1-22.13 observes the TLS/DTLS/QUIC externally observable wire or state; there is no wire trace in the atlas to close.

no plane in 22.1-22.13 observes loader/provider symbol lookup; 22.6 sees DT_NEEDED edges and 22.7 sees engine registration, but neither sees the dlopen/dlsym lookup path a module/engine/provider surface exercises.

body.x509_derivation: The X.509 slice membership is the union over the named roots of the X.509 members of the declared compatibility roots. Each named root's rule is recorded in x509_named_roots; the units are the authority's own (crypto/x509/pcy_* for the policy tree, x509_trust.c for trust, v3_purp.c for purpose, x_crl.c/v3_crld.c for CRL, v3_ncons.c for name constraints), and the X509* prefix covers the X509, X509_STORE, X509_STORE_CTX, X509_VERIFY_PARAM and X509_verify_cert roots. `_openssl_ascii2ebcdic` and `_openssl_ebcdic2ascii` (ebcdic.h) are not matched by any rule and no X.509 root reaches them.

X509.rule: declared-root members named exactly `X509` or starting `X509_`

X509_STORE.rule: declared-root members named exactly `X509_STORE` or starting `X509_STORE_`

X509_STORE_CTX.rule: declared-root members named exactly `X509_STORE_CTX` or starting `X509_STORE_CTX_`

X509_VERIFY_PARAM.rule: declared-root members named exactly `X509_VERIFY_PARAM` or starting `X509_VERIFY_PARAM_`

X509_verify_cert.rule: declared-root members named exactly `X509_verify_cert` or starting `X509_verify_cert_`

crl.rule: declared-root members defined in crypto/x509/x_crl.c or crypto/x509/v3_crld.c

policy-tree.rule: declared-root members defined in crypto/x509/pcy_*.{c,h} (the policy tree)

verification-callbacks.rule: callback-slot targets defined under crypto/x509/, plus declared-root members named `X509_VERIFY*` or ending `verify_cb`
